title: The Press Layer of the Crimson Hexagonal Archive: Journal and Imprint Architectural Specification (EA-PRESS-ARCH-01 v1.0)
creator: Lee Sharks; Johannes Sigil
description:
A v1.0 operative architectural specification by Lee Sharks and Johannes Sigil defining the Crimson Hexagonal Archive’s press layer as two imprints plus a distributed journal family.

**Pergamon Press** is assigned to journals and scholarly working papers; **New Human Press** to creative releases and book-length theoretical editions. The specification forbids placing imprint names in journal fields or journal names in imprint fields, ratifies canonical venue strings, records a June 11, 2026 inventory and assignment log, and treats venue backfill as a retrocausal canonical operation under earlier archive instruments. Several strings and assignment questions remained open in this version, so the document is a dated architecture and governance record rather than a complete statement of all later repository normalization.
